items.title: Content depth insufficient for March 2024 Core Update standards
items.description: Recent Google Core Update emphasizes substantial original value over thin affiliate content. While we have 54 blog posts with proper structure, many lack the depth of original research, case studies, and first-hand insights required to compete against established financial/insurance publications.
items.recommendation: Enhance top 20 performing posts with original research elements: lead conversion data analysis, exclusive AgedLeadStore performance metrics, detailed ROI calculations with real numbers, and interview quotes from successful agents. Add 'Key Takeaways' sections and downloadable resources.

items.title: YMYL expertise demonstration needs strengthening for December 2024 guidelines
items.description: Updated E-E-A-T guidelines require stronger demonstration of real-world experience for financial/insurance YMYL content. Bill Rice's credentials exist in Person schema but aren't prominently displayed on content pages where users make financial decisions.
items.recommendation: Add prominent author bio boxes to all YMYL content pages featuring Bill Rice's specific insurance/financial industry experience, certifications, years in lead generation, and quantified results. Include 'About the Author' sections with relevant credentials for each vertical (insurance licensing, mortgage industry experience, etc.).

items.title: Affiliate disclosure prominence insufficient for FTC 2024 standards
items.description: While affiliate disclosures exist site-wide, they may not meet FTC's 'clear and conspicuous' standard, especially on mobile devices. Recent FTC enforcement emphasizes disclosure visibility before users click affiliate links.
items.recommendation: Add prominent affiliate disclosure boxes at the top of each post containing affiliate links, with clear language like 'This post contains affiliate links. We earn a commission if you purchase through our links at no extra cost to you.' Ensure disclosure appears above the fold on mobile devices.

items.title: Missing Product schema reduces rich results eligibility
items.description: Lead type pages lack Product schema markup, missing opportunities for rich results in Google Search. This is particularly important for competitive commercial queries where rich snippets improve click-through rates.
items.recommendation: Implement Product schema on all 8 lead type pages with proper aggregateRating, offers, and review properties. Include pricing information, availability, and authentic review data from AgedLeadStore customers where available.

items.title: Core Web Vitals INP optimization needed for May 2024 thresholds
items.description: New Interaction to Next Paint (INP) Core Web Vital replacing FID requires optimization for overall page responsiveness. Affiliate sites with multiple tracking scripts and forms are particularly susceptible to INP issues.
items.recommendation: Audit INP scores using PageSpeed Insights and Chrome DevTools. Optimize affiliate link tracking in lib/affiliate.ts to use passive event listeners, implement code splitting for non-critical JavaScript, and defer non-essential third-party scripts. Target INP < 200ms.

items.title: Content pillar gaps undermine topical authority
items.description: Site structure shows 0 playbooks and 0 guides despite content pillars mentioning 'Vertical Playbooks' and 'Role Guides'. This gap between promised and delivered content weakens topical authority signals that Google uses for ranking.
items.recommendation: Create comprehensive playbook content for each major vertical (insurance, mortgage, solar, home improvement) and role-specific guides (new agents, experienced brokers, team managers). Start with 2-3 flagship playbooks featuring step-by-step processes, templates, and checklists.

items.title: Glossary cross-linking underutilized for topic authority
items.description: 77 glossary terms represent significant topical authority potential, but cross-linking between glossary, blog posts, and lead type pages appears limited. This misses opportunities to demonstrate comprehensive topic coverage to Google.
items.recommendation: Implement automated internal linking system to connect glossary terms with relevant blog posts and lead type pages. Add 'Related Terms' sections to each glossary entry and contextual links within blog content. Create topic clusters around major themes (lead scoring, compliance, pricing).

items.title: Content freshness strategy needed for competitive topics
items.description: Recent post titles show 2026 dates, but competitive lead generation topics require regular updates to maintain rankings. Google's Helpful Content system favors sites that keep information current, especially for pricing and industry changes.
items.recommendation: Establish quarterly content refresh schedule for high-traffic posts, especially pricing guides and market analysis. Add 'Last Updated' dates prominently on posts, create content calendar for seasonal updates (ACA enrollment periods, insurance regulation changes), and monitor competitor content freshness.

items.title: Case studies lack verifiable sourcing for credibility
items.description: While content demonstrates industry knowledge, case studies and success stories lack specific attribution or verifiable sources, which weakens trust signals important for YMYL content in financial services.
items.recommendation: Develop 3-5 detailed case studies with anonymized but specific data (ROI percentages, conversion rates, time periods). Include methodology sections, before/after comparisons, and where possible, customer testimonials with permission. Focus on AgedLeadStore success stories.

items.title: FAQ schema opportunities on glossary pages
items.description: Glossary pages could benefit from FAQ schema markup to capture featured snippets for definition-based queries, which are common in the lead generation industry.
items.recommendation: Add FAQ schema to glossary pages with common questions like 'What is [term]?', 'How does [term] work?', 'Why is [term] important?' This can help capture featured snippets and improve visibility for educational queries.

items.title: 21 blog posts missing featured images impact E-E-A-T signals
items.description: Featured images are critical for E-E-A-T signals, social sharing, and user engagement. Missing images on recent posts like 'auto-insurance-aged-leads-cross-sell-strategy-double-revenue' and 'best-aged-lead-providers-compared-where-to-buy-aged-leads-2026' reduce content quality perception and may impact rankings under the March 2024 Core Update's focus on content quality.
items.recommendation: Create custom featured images for all posts within 2 weeks. Use data visualizations for posts with statistics, process diagrams for strategy posts, and comparison charts for provider reviews. Implement WebP format with proper alt text and structured data ImageObject markup.

items.description: With November 2024 Search Quality Guidelines emphasizing E-E-A-T for YMYL-adjacent financial content, Bill Rice's expertise needs more prominent display. Current Person schema lacks sufficient credentials for insurance/mortgage content authority.
items.recommendation: Enhance Bill Rice's author bio with specific insurance industry credentials, years of experience, client testimonials, and speaking engagements. Add 'hasCredential' schema property, create dedicated author page with portfolio, and include author bylines with expertise indicators on all YMYL content.

items.recommendation: Implement Product schema for all lead type pages with aggregateRating, offers (price ranges), and review properties. Include 'category' and 'audience' properties to signal relevance for specific professional verticals.

items.recommendation: Create custom featured images for all 18 posts using data visualizations, process diagrams, or industry-specific graphics. Include alt text with target keywords and ensure images are optimized for Core Web Vitals.

items.description: December 2023 Helpful Content Update specifically scrutinized affiliate sites for disclosure prominence. Current site-wide disclosure may not meet FTC's 'clear and conspicuous' standard for all content types.
items.recommendation: Add per-post affiliate disclosures above the fold on all content with affiliate links. Include disclosure in email newsletters and social media posts. Create dedicated disclosure page linked from footer and implement disclosure schema markup using 'hasPart' property.

items.description: Content pillars show 0 playbooks and 0 guides despite being core content types. This gap may signal incomplete expertise coverage to Google's Helpful Content system, which now better detects comprehensive topic coverage.
items.recommendation: Create 3-5 comprehensive playbooks for top verticals (insurance agents, mortgage brokers, PI attorneys) and 5-8 tactical guides covering lead nurturing, CRM setup, and compliance. Use pillar-cluster architecture linking related blog posts to establish topical authority.

items.recommendation: Either remove these pillars from navigation/schema or prioritize creating 2-3 comprehensive playbooks and guides. Focus on high-value topics like 'Insurance Agent's 90-Day Aged Lead Playbook' or 'Mortgage Broker's Lead Nurturing Guide'.

items.title: Core Web Vitals optimization needed for INP compliance
items.description: With Google's May 2024 introduction of Interaction to Next Paint (INP) as a Core Web Vital, affiliate sites must optimize for responsiveness throughout user sessions, particularly on forms and affiliate link interactions.
items.recommendation: Implement INP monitoring and optimize affiliate link click handlers, form interactions, and any dynamic content loading. Use React.lazy for code splitting and optimize UTM parameter handling in affiliate.ts to reduce interaction delays.

items.recommendation: Implement Product schema for each lead type page, including aggregateRating (if available), offers, and detailed descriptions. Ensure compliance with Google's updated Product schema guidelines for affiliate content.

items.description: While site has affiliate disclosures, the March 2024 Core Update and ongoing helpful content system updates require more prominent, contextual disclosures that clearly explain the affiliate relationship and potential bias.
items.recommendation: Add contextual affiliate disclosures within article content, especially near affiliate links and product recommendations. Include clear language about compensation and potential bias. Consider adding disclosure to article schema as well.

items.description: Posts like 'Aged Lead Call Recording Analysis: 500 Conversations Reveal' make data claims without clear sourcing methodology, which may not meet E-E-A-T standards for experience evidence.
items.recommendation: Add methodology sections to data-driven posts explaining data collection, sample sizes, and analysis methods. Include disclaimers about data limitations and create 'about our research' page explaining data standards. Consider third-party validation for major claims.

items.title: Sitemap optimization for content hierarchy
items.description: 137 sitemap entries may not optimally represent content hierarchy and priority signals to search engines, particularly for the glossary and lead type pages that should have higher priority.
items.recommendation: Implement sitemap index with separate sitemaps for content types (blog, glossary, lead-types). Add priority values (0.8 for lead types, 0.6 for recent blog posts, 0.4 for glossary) and appropriate changefreq values. Exclude low-value pages like tag archives.
